svg.aria-label: How to make a Mint Julep, step by step: Mint and syrup. Add the mint leaves and simple syrup to a julep cup. Muddle, gently. Press the mint a few times, just enough to wake it up. Bourbon and crushed ice. Add the bourbon, then pack the cup with crushed ice. Stir until it frosts. Stir until the outside of the cup frosts over, then heap more ice on top. Garnish. A big bouquet of mint, right by the straw, so you smell it with every sip. Cheers!
